mechanism: Both drugs have sympathomimetic and CNS stimulant properties that may be additive, increasing cardiovascular and neuropsychiatric effects; varenicline is a partial agonist at α4β2 nicotinic receptors which can potentiate stimulant effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and psychiatric symptoms closely; consider baseline and periodic cardiovascular assessment; adjust methylphenidate dose if needed and counsel patient on signs of excessive stimulation.
